game: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City (PC digital)
what_removed: Game temporarily pulled from digital PC stores; reported link to Michael Jackson's "Wanna Be Startin' Somethin'" (Sony Music reported as claimant, unconfirmed)
why_reported: Rockstar statement: "Due to some music licensing issues, we've had to temporarily remove Vice City PC from digital stores."

game: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City (PC digital re-release incl. Steam; mobile 10th anniversary release)
what_removed: Billie Jean and Wanna Be Startin' Somethin' (Michael Jackson), Bark at the Moon (Ozzy Osbourne), Wow (Kate Bush), Rockit (Herbie Hancock), Looking for the Perfect Beat (Afrika Bambaataa), Running with the Night (Lionel Richie), plus "a couple of songs from Radio Espantoso" (list attributed to Rockstar Nexus)
why_reported: Music licensing (follows Rockstar's November 2012 licensing statement)

game: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas (Steam PC update; matches mobile and Xbox 360 HD versions)
what_removed: 17 licensed songs (plus high-resolution options); same 17 already absent from the mobile version and the Xbox 360 HD port of it
why_reported: Press: seemingly expired song licences; no Rockstar statement

game: Grand Theft Auto IV and Episodes from Liberty City
what_removed: Tracks across 10 stations; Vladivostok FM hit hardest (15 per Game Informer), also Liberty Rock Radio, The Journey, Vice City FM and others; 11 replacements added to Vladivostok FM
count: 43 entries listed by Game Informer (no total stated in the article); Destructoid reports over 50 / 51 entries incl. Episodes and an unused track (not checked here); sources disagree
why_reported: Game Informer: the ten-year licensing deal running out; Rockstar had earlier confirmed it would remove a number of songs (no statement quoted in this source)

Mentioned in passing by LevelUp as the first song GTA V lost, removed in 2018; GTA Wiki (Space 103.2 page) instead says it was removed in the Los Santos Tuners update (2021); single secondary source, unverified

game: Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition (Vice City and San Andreas)
what_removed: Launch track list missing 20 Vice City and 18 San Andreas songs, incl. Billie Jean and Wanna Be Startin' Somethin' (Michael Jackson), Killing in the Name (Rage Against the Machine), Express Yourself (N.W.A.); a November 2021 update to the article says Rockstar sent an amended list with "a number of tracks reinstated", without counts or names on the page
count: 38 at first report; residual after the amended list not stated
why_reported: VGC: Rockstar confirmed the game "will be missing some music from its soundtrack" (paraphrased, no direct quote); dataminers reportedly found the PC version "contains all the music that's no longer licensed"

game: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced (PC; consoles expected)
what_removed: Moloko, "The Time Is Now" (2000), from Non-Stop-Pop FM, via hotfix spotted by dataminers
why_reported: No Rockstar statement; press calls an expired, unrenewed licence the likely explanation

source.publication: GTA BOOM (Ray Ampoloquio, updated 2026-09-17 by Matt Gibbs)
